name: nf-tax-interest
description: Establish selected Australian tax interest and debt treatment for Norfolk Island taxpayers in 2026. Use for general interest charge, shortfall interest, amended assessments, quarterly rates, payment allocation, deduction timing, remission and disputed debt. Covers separate liability, accrual and incurred dates, calendar-year divisors, compounding, substituted accounting periods, recoupments and review thresholds. Includes primary legislation, current authority guidance and fictional boundary components. Requires actual assessments, notices, payment receipt and allocation, income-year start and verified interest periods. Preserves applicable workflow outputs and holds unresolved facts, specialist regimes and actual submissions for professional review. This draft does not complete the compliance or country pack.
